title: WorkSkillRouting - Tooling API
description: Represents a setup object that stores a set of WorkSkillRoutingAttribute objects used to route a work item to an agent who has the skills necessary to take the work. Available in API version 46.0 and later.

DeveloperName.description: The developer name for the WorkSkillRouting. Note: Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

FullName.description: The full name of the associated metadata type in Metadata API.

IsActive.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsActive.description: Indicates whether assignment rules are active and can be evaluated.

Language.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Language.description: The language in the user’s personal settings.

MasterLabel.description: Master label for this object. This display value is the internal label that is not translated.

Metadata.description: The associated metadata type in Metadata API.

RelatedEntity.properties: Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Unique
RelatedEntity.description: Type of Salesforce object that the attributes are associated with.
